description: ReportsPage Filament page with filter form and Excel/PDF export actions, plus the complete Phase5Test.php with all 7 test cases. Independent of FEAT-002 (widgets) but depends on FEAT-001 services. Run the full test suite at the end.
steps:
2. Create resources/views/filament/pages/reports-page.blade.php.
   — Use Filament's x-filament::page wrapper or extend Filament's base layout.
   — Include {{ $this->form }} to render the filter form.
   — Add two Filament action buttons rendered via wire:click: 'تصدير Excel' calls exportExcel(), 'تصدير PDF' calls exportPdf().
   — Style: Tailwind classes consistent with Filament. Use x-filament::button for each export button.

3. Create tests/Feature/Phase5Test.php.
   Follow the exact pattern from tests/Feature/Phase4Test.php: top-level it() functions, use createHierarchy() helper, no describe() blocks needed (flat structure is fine).

   Test 1 — 'DashboardStatsService::schoolStatusCounts returns correct counts per status':
   Create school org from createHierarchy(). Create 2 APPROVED + 1 SUBMITTED + 1 REJECTED leave requests in that school (use LeaveRequest::create() directly, not factory, to control organization_id). Call app(DashboardStatsService::class)->schoolStatusCounts($school). Assert counts['approved']==2, counts['submitted']==1, counts['rejected']==1.

   Test 2 — 'DashboardStatsService::onLeaveToday returns only employees on leave today':
   Create school, employee, leaveType, user. Create one APPROVED request with start_date=today, end_date=today+2 (spans today). Create one APPROVED request with start_date=yesterday->subDays(5), end_date=yesterday (ended yesterday). Call onLeaveToday($school). Assert returned collection has count 1.

   Test 3 — 'DashboardStatsService::topLeaveTakers orders by total approved days desc':
   Create hierarchy. Create 2 employees in school. Employee A: 1 APPROVED request with days=10. Employee B: 1 APPROVED request with days=5. Call topLeaveTakers($adm). Assert first result's full_name == Employee A's full_name and total_days >= 10.

   Test 4 — 'DashboardStatsService::monthlyRequestTrend returns 12 months with correct counts':
   Create directorate from hierarchy. Create 2 leave requests with created_at in January of current year (use LeaveRequest::create([...'created_at'=>Carbon::create(now()->year,1,15)])) in the directorate's subtree. Call monthlyRequestTrend($dir, now()->year). Assert count($result)==12. Assert $result[0]>=2 (index 0 = January).

   Test 5 — 'DashboardStatsService::overdueCount respects org subtree':
   Create hierarchy with dir → adm → school1 and a separate school2 outside the adm subtree (create a second adm). Create 2 overdue SUBMITTED requests (submitted_at = now()->subDays(5)) in school1. Create 1 overdue request in school2. Call overdueCount($adm). Assert result==2. Call overdueCount(null). Assert result>=3.

   Test 6 — 'ReportPdfService::generateSummary returns non-empty PDF binary':
   Create hierarchy, employee, leaveType, user. Create 1 APPROVED request. Call app(ReportPdfService::class)->generateSummary([]). Assert strlen($pdf)>0. Assert str_starts_with($pdf,'%PDF').

   Test 7 — 'SchoolStatusOverview canView returns false for administration user':
   Create hierarchy. Create user with organization_id = $adm->id (administration org). Login as this user: $this->actingAs($user). Assert App\Filament\Widgets\School\SchoolStatusOverview::canView() === false.
